Last season I did not put much cash on this small maize plot, but because this land is mine I will not leave it empty of inputs. I will use a little chemical fertilizer and manure, and I will plant improved seed if I can get it from the cooperative on time, because on maize the better seed pays only when I also feed it a bit. I will not irrigate because I depend on the rain, and I will not spend money on spray for this plot unless there is a serious problem, so I will do the weeding with family labor.
